material:
name: ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test
note: ci-schedule-persistence-model: lib.codec.schedule_entries/persistence_answer via decode(rep='schedule_entries', transform=<field>[@what][!filename], key=<accepted csv>) ; decoy -> no persistence row -> None (oracle stdout: 'False')
generator_cmd: sh tests/data/script_fixtures/sched_persist_gen.sh <dir>  (writes gha_benign.yml: hand-authored heredoc; no lib code); sched_persist_fx.py writes the json
oracle_cmd: (cd <dir> && python3 -I -c "import yaml,sys;y=yaml.safe_load(open(sys.argv[1]));on=y.get(True,y.get('on'));print('schedule' in on or 'workflow_run' in on)" gha_benign.yml  # False)
